"""Register clear/occluded stationary-readout pairs; preserve every existing label and split."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
import cv2,numpy as np
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
DATA=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
corpus_path=DATA/'out/coordinate-label-expansion-20261015/expanded-corpus-v5.json'
corpus=read(corpus_path);frames={int(f['id'][-6:]):f for f in corpus['frames']}
candidates=read(ROOT/'minimap-stationary-candidates.json')
v1=read(DATA/'out/coordinate-finetune-20261015/split-manifest.json')
v2=read(DATA/'out/coordinate-finetune-20261015/coverage-v2/coverage-manifest.json')
v2index={r['id']:r for r in v2['rows']}
definitions=[('grass-still-744-753',744,753,[744,746,747],[748,749,750,751,752,753]),
             ('grass-still-776-787',776,787,[778,779,782],[776,777,780,781,783,784,785,786,787]),
             ('grass-still-884-900',884,900,[884],[885,886,887,888,889,890,891,892,893,894,895,896,897,898,899,900])]
groups=[]
for name,lo,hi,clear,obscured in definitions:
    expected=frames[lo]['expected'];members=[]
    metric=next(g for g in candidates['groups'] if g['first']==lo and g['last']==hi)
    assert all(p.get('inliers',0)>=60 and p['centerDisplacementPixels']<.5 and min(p['inlierSpan'])>75 for p in metric['comparisons'])
    for n in range(lo,hi+1):
        f=frames[n];assert f['state']=='present' and f['expected']==expected
        assert sha(Path(f['image']))==f['captureSHA256']
        assert sha(Path(f['minimap']['image']))==f['minimap']['sha256']
        v1split=next(k for k in ['train','developmentHoldout','purged'] if f['id'] in v1[k])
        members.append({'id':f['id'],'frame':n,'image':f['image'],'imageSHA256':f['captureSHA256'],
            'minimap':f['minimap']['image'],'minimapSHA256':f['minimap']['sha256'],
            'viewRole':'clearer-anchor' if n in clear else 'grass-overlap',
            'existingV1Split':v1split,'existingV2Split':v2index[f['id']]['split']})
    before=frames[lo-1]['expected'];after=frames[hi+1]['expected']
    assert before!=expected and after!=expected
    groups.append({'id':name,'first':lo,'last':hi,'frames':hi-lo+1,'expected':expected,
        'humanVerified':False,'coordinateEvidence':'Assistant visually checked original coordinate strips, including all frames and clearer anchors. Existing per-frame labels agree; no new or rewritten labels.',
        'positionEvidence':'Paired minimap terrain alignment excludes central arrow and overlay regions; stable to <0.5 pixel. Does not prove zero movement below displayed coordinate precision.',
        'clearerAnchors':clear,'grassOverlap':obscured,'minimapComparisons':metric['comparisons'],
        'movingBoundaries':{'before':{'frame':lo-1,'expected':before},'after':{'frame':hi+1,'expected':after}},
        'nextSplitConstraint':'Keep this entire group in one partition; no clearer-anchor training / obscured-frame validation leakage.',
        'members':members})

# Actual model evidence: v2's held-out group is entirely in its new development block.
model_evidence=[]
for model in ['initial','previous','coverage-only','coverage-positive']:
    path=DATA/f'out/coordinate-finetune-20261015/coverage-v2/replay-{model}.json';raw=read(path)
    for mode in ['ppocr-contrast-clock','ppocr-corroborated-clock']:
        part=[r for r in raw['pipelines'][mode] if 776<=int(r['id'].split('@')[0][-6:])<=787]
        assert len(part)==12
        observations=[]
        for p in part:
            f=frames[int(p['id'].split('@')[0][-6:])];s=p['selected']
            observations.append({'id':p['id'],'selected':s,'rawText':p.get('rawText'),
                'exactXYZ':s is not None and all(s[k]==f['expected'][k] for k in 'xyz')})
        model_evidence.append({'model':model,'mode':mode,'group':'grass-still-776-787',
            'correct':sum(r['exactXYZ'] for r in observations),'missed':sum(r['selected'] is None for r in observations),
            'wrong':sum(r['selected'] is not None and not r['exactXYZ'] for r in observations),
            'sourceFile':str(path),'sourceSHA256':sha(path),'predictions':observations,
            'trainingOverlap':model=='previous'})

result={'purpose':'Clear/grass-occluded pairs at stable displayed XYZ, supported by paired minimaps; data organization only, no retraining or pipeline change.',
    'sourceCorpus':str(corpus_path),'sourceCorpusSHA256':sha(corpus_path),
    'newLabels':0,'modifiedLabels':0,'humanVerified':False,'independentAcceptance':False,
    'positiveXFramesInSelectedGroups':0,'groups':groups,'modelEvidence':model_evidence,
    'limitations':['Existing negative-X grass examples; do not fill positive-X coverage by changing signs.',
        'Clear/obscured frame roles are relative assistant visual judgments, not a numerical readability guarantee.',
        'Minimap agreement alone cannot transfer exact XYZ or distinguish movement smaller than the displayed integer.',
        'Group 744-753 spans train/purged in v2, not train/development. No existing split is rewritten.',
        'Other repeated-readout runs not promoted automatically: 1-5 insufficient minimap features; 652-656 dark sparse map lacks strong positional evidence.']}
(ROOT/'stationary-groups.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
target=SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr/annotations/20261015-session-1F638949/stationary-grass-groups-v1.json'
crosscheck=read(ROOT/'stationary-verification.json')
assert crosscheck['sourceGroupsSHA256']==sha(ROOT/'stationary-groups.json')
target.write_text(json.dumps({**result,'localEvidenceRoot':str(ROOT),
    'recipe':{'path':str(Path(__file__)),'sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'text':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')},
    'localCandidateMetricsSHA256':sha(ROOT/'minimap-stationary-candidates.json'),
    'independentMinimapCheck':crosscheck},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for g in groups:
    print(g['id'],g['frames'],g['expected'],'max map drift',max(p['centerDisplacementPixels'] for p in g['minimapComparisons']))
for m in model_evidence:print(m['model'],m['mode'],'correct',m['correct'],'wrong',m['wrong'],'miss',m['missed'])
